Effective date: %3$s

Trackly is a habit tracker made by %1$s. This policy explains what happens to your data when you use the app. In short: your habits stay on your phone.

# Summary
• No account and no sign-up.
• No advertising, no analytics and no tracking.
• Your habits, history, reminders and settings are stored only on your device.
• We do not collect, sell or share your personal data.

# Data stored on your device
The app stores the habits you create, the progress you log, your reminders and your settings in its private storage on your device. This data is not sent to us or to anyone else. Other apps cannot read it.

# Android backup
If backup is turned on in your phone's settings, Android may include the app's data in your device backup in your Google account, so it can be restored on a new phone. This backup is managed by Google under its own privacy policy, and you can turn it off in Android settings.

# Your own backups and exports
If you use "Back up to a file" or "Export to CSV", the app writes a file to the place you choose, for example your phone or a cloud drive. The file is handled by that storage provider. We never receive it.

# Purchases
Trackly Premium is sold through Google Play. Payments are processed by Google; we never receive your card or payment details. The app asks Google Play only whether you own Premium. Google's privacy policy applies to purchases: https://policies.google.com/privacy

# Ratings
The app may show Google Play's rating dialog. Ratings and reviews go to Google Play, not to us.

# Permissions
• Notifications — to show the habit reminders you set.
• Run at startup — to restore your reminders after the phone restarts.
• Vibration — for reminder vibration.

# Children
The app is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect any data from them.

# Deleting your data
You can delete a habit and its history in the app at any time. Uninstalling the app, or clearing its storage in Android settings, deletes all data stored by the app. Backup files you created stay where you saved them until you delete them.

# Changes to this policy
If this policy changes, the updated version will be published in the app and on the app's website with a new effective date.

# Contact

Effective date: %3$s

These terms apply to your use of the Trackly app, made by %1$s. By using the app you agree to them.

# The app
Trackly helps you track habits and goals. The free version can be used without payment and without an account. We work to keep the app reliable, but we cannot guarantee that it will always be available or free of errors.

# Trackly Premium
Premium unlocks additional features inside the app. It is offered as an auto-renewing subscription (for example monthly or yearly) and, where available, as a one-time "lifetime" purchase. Prices are shown in Google Play before you buy and may differ by country.

# Subscriptions and renewal
• Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm the purchase.
• A subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
• If a free trial is offered, you are charged when the trial ends unless you cancel before then.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Google Play: Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions. Cancelling stops future renewals; Premium stays active until the end of the paid period.

# Refunds
Purchases are processed by Google Play, and refunds follow Google Play's refund policies. You can request a refund through Google Play.

# Your data
Your habit data is stored on your device. You are responsible for keeping your own backups, for example with the app's "Back up to a file" feature. See the Privacy Policy for details.

# Acceptable use
Do not misuse the app, try to break it, bypass its purchase checks or reverse engineer it beyond what the law allows.

# Health disclaimer
Trackly is a personal organisation tool. It does not provide medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting any new exercise, diet or health routine.

# Liability
The app is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from its use. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer law in your country.

# Changes
We may update these terms. The current version is always available in the app and on the app's website.

# Contact
%2$s
You can contact the developer through the e-mail address shown on Trackly\'s page in Google Play.
